facts.value: Ministry of Environment. Responsible for environmental protection, industrial pollution control, waste regulation, air and water quality, environmental impact assessments, and enforcement of environmental law. Handles complaints about illegal dumping, industrial pollution, air quality violations, river/coastal pollution, and quarry/crusher noise. Complaint domains encoded for routing: air_pollution, industrial_pollution, river_pollution, coastal_pollution, illegal_quarry, crusher_dust, hazardous_waste_dumping, noise_from_industry, environmental_law_violation, EIA_complaint, pesticide_misuse, medical_waste_disposal, chemical_factory_violation.

Not responsible for / boundary conditions: municipal_waste_collection(MUN); fire_response(CD); water_utility_supply(water_establishments); building_permits(municipalities); routine_household_collection_and_street_sweeping; Route instead to MUN when MOE is regulatory/environmental layer not daily local pickup by default.; sole_handling_of_hazardous_medical_chemical_or_industrial_waste; Route instead to MOE when Municipality may assist with location or containment but MOE is regulator.; potable_water_outage_or_customer_water_billing; Route instead to WATER_ESTABLISHMENT_BY_LOCATION when Environmental pollution is separate from water utility customer service.
facts.notes: Runtime cases may still require HITL when asset ownership, location, or public/private responsibility is ambiguous.

facts.value: Geographic scope: national. Route hazardous/medical/chemical/industrial waste to MOE with local municipality context and HITL. Route suspected industrial pollution to MOE and keep municipality as location/context secondary. Route river/stream pollution to MOE; keep HITL for utility sewage irrigation or municipal source boundary. Route quarry/crusher environmental complaints to MOE with municipal context and HITL.
facts.notes: Runtime routing may still need exact location, dynamic municipal resolution, or asset-owner confirmation.
